title: Tobias Beckett
description: Tobias Beckett was a charismatic con artist and professional thief who hailed from Glee Anselm. Alongside his loyal crew, he pulled off a number of heists and jobs and always knew all the angles. While pulling a job for Crimson Dawn, Beckett met Han Solo and took him under his wing, teaching him that trust had its limits, even though he still had trouble learning that lesson himself at the end.
